description: This file defines a final class ImmutableJsonArrayBuilder that implements the JsonArrayBuilder interface. It provides methods to build an immutable JSON array by adding, setting, removing, and retrieving JSON values of various types (integers, longs, doubles, booleans, strings, and JsonValue objects). It maintains an internal list of JsonValue objects and offers a fluent API to construct complex JSON arrays.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArrayBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating immutable JSON array instances by accumulating various JsonValue elements and supporting fluent API methods for addition, setting, removal, and retrieval of elements.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ImmutableJsonArrayBuilder.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Overloaded methods to add various types of values (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue) along with optional further values.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value at a specified index with various types (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue).

methods.name: addIntegers
methods.description: Adds multiple Integer values from an Iterable.

methods.name: addLongs
methods.description: Adds multiple Long values from an Iterable.

methods.name: addDoubles
methods.description: Adds multiple Double values from an Iterable.

methods.name: addBooleans
methods.description: Adds multiple Boolean values from an Iterable.

methods.name: addStrings
methods.description: Adds multiple String values from an Iterable.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Utility method to get a Stream from an Iterable.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the JsonValue at a specified index, wrapped in Optional.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the value at the specified index or the specified JsonValue.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a Stream of JsonValue objects contained in the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an ImmutableJsonArray from the current values.
